WITH base_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    p.subject_id,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.admittime,
    a.dischtime,
    a.hospital_expire_flag,
    p.anchor_age,
    -- Define 72h window
    TIMESTAMP_ADD(a.admittime, INTERVAL 72 HOUR) AS window_end
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
      USING (subject_id)
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'F'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 68 AND 78
),
hhs_flag AS (
  SELECT
    bc.*,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
        JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_icd_diagnoses` dd
          USING (icd_code, icd_version)
        WHERE
          d.hadm_id = bc.hadm_id
          AND LOWER(dd.long_title) LIKE '%hyperosmolar%'
      ) THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS has_hhs
  FROM base_cohort bc
),
med_counts AS (
  SELECT
    hf.subject_id,
    hf.hadm_id,
    hf.has_hhs,
    -- Count of distinct drugs in first 72h
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.drug) AS med_complexity,
    -- Count of distinct hyperkalemia-risk drugs in first 72h
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN LOWER(pr.drug) IN (
        'spironolactone', 'eplerenone',
        'lisinopril', 'enalapril', 'ramipril',
        'losartan', 'valsartan',
        'trimethoprim', 'pentamidine',
        'potassium chloride', 'potassium citrate'
      ) THEN pr.drug
    END) AS hyperk_count,
    -- LOS in hours
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(hf.dischtime, hf.admittime, HOUR) AS los_hrs,
    hf.hospital_expire_flag
  FROM
    hhs_flag hf
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.prescriptions` pr
      ON pr.hadm_id = hf.hadm_id
      AND pr.starttime < hf.window_end
      AND pr.stoptime > hf.admittime
  GROUP BY
    hf.subject_id, hf.hadm_id, hf.has_hhs, hf.admittime, hf.dischtime, hf.hospital_expire_flag
),
percentiles AS (
  SELECT
    mc.*,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hyperk_count) AS hyperk_pr
  FROM med_counts mc
),
los_cutoff AS (
  SELECT
    APPROX_QUANTILES(los_hrs, 4)[OFFSET(3)] AS los_75th
  FROM percentiles
),
final_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN has_hhs THEN 'HHS' ELSE 'Non-HHS' END AS cohort,
    -- Medication complexity distribution: we can compute simple buckets
    PERCENTILE_CONT(med_complexity, 0.25) OVER (PARTITION BY has_hhs) AS med_complex_25,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(med_complexity, 0.50) OVER (PARTITION BY has_hhs) AS med_complex_50,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(med_complexity, 0.75) OVER (PARTITION BY has_hhs) AS med_complex_75,
    -- Median percentile rank of hyperk risk drugs
    PERCENTILE_CONT(hyperk_pr, 0.50) OVER (PARTITION BY has_hhs) AS median_hyperk_pr,
    -- Percent affected (hyperk_count > 0)
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN hyperk_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) 
      OVER (PARTITION BY has_hhs) AS pct_hyperk_affected,
    -- Percent in top-quartile LOS
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN los_hrs >= (SELECT los_75th FROM los_cutoff) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY has_hhs) / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY has_hhs)
      AS pct_top_quartile_los,
    -- Mortality among those in top-quartile LOS
    100.0 * SUM(CASE 
        WHEN los_hrs >= (SELECT los_75th FROM los_cutoff) 
             AND hospital_expire_flag = 1
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY has_hhs)
      /
      NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN los_hrs >= (SELECT los_75th FROM los_cutoff) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (PARTITION BY has_hhs), 0)
      AS mort_top_quartile_los
  FROM percentiles
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  cohort,
  med_complex_25,
  med_complex_50,
  med_complex_75,
  median_hyperk_pr,
  pct_hyperk_affected,
  pct_top_quartile_los,
  mort_top_quartile_los
FROM final_metrics
ORDER BY cohort;
